== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text (the PC website card list). No published image shows this text. Other versions: [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (original), [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition. May not be Disarmed.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L5730</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>12_16</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB5-45-Master_Qui_Gon-PC-E1-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
